lead_raw_text:
The structure of Dy6Ni10Bi6 (reduced formula Dy3Ni5Bi3) crystallizes in the trigonal space group R-3m (No. 166), with 22 atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Bi centers with 13 neighbors (6 Dy, 3 Ni, 4 Bi), Dy centers with 15 neighbors (8 Ni, 7 Bi), and Ni centers in two environments: 10 neighbors (3 Bi, 6 Dy, 1 Ni) and 6 neighbors (3 Bi, 3 Dy). The periodic neighbor graph is fully connected in three dimensions, and validated polyhedron contacts include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Ni 10-vertex polyhedra and corner- and face-sharing between Bi 13-vertex and Dy 15-vertex polyhedra.
